statement: External invoice fraud — an impersonator registered a lookalike vendor, invoiced under the real vendor's name, and collected the payment into a fresh mule account. Disposition: recall the payment, escalate to the fraud unit, notify the bank.
discriminatingTests: Pull the vendor-master audit log and the AP clerk's session records (q1)
Check the invoice email's SPF/DKIM headers and originating IP (q2)

statement: Inside job — AP clerk Mara Hart created the fake vendor record and approved the payment herself; the real vendor's denial is an unrelated coincidence.
discriminatingTests: Pull the vendor-master audit log and session records (q1)

statement: Payment diversion (BEC) — a genuine invoice from the real vendor was paid into an account an attacker swapped in.
discriminatingTests: Trace the purchase order and any bank-detail change request (q4)

statement: Honest error — a genuine invoice was paid to a wrongly configured new vendor account through clerical mistakes in onboarding.
discriminatingTests: Trace the purchase order behind the invoice (q4)
